newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq closes higher in rebound.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq closes higher in rebound.

text.p: Nasdaq shares closed higher on Monday in a rebound led by Intel Corp and Microsoft Corp, traders said.
The Nasdaq composite index rose 2.18 points or 0.17 percent to close unofficially at 1311.18. Losing issues beat gainers 2377 to 1902 on total volume of 541 million shares.
Monday's close ended a streak of three straight losing sessions.
"Techs had been pretty beaten up in in the last several sessions," said Arnie Owen, director of equities at Kaufman Brothers. "Today was just a pretty good across-the-board tech rally."
Semiconductor stocks were led by Intel, which rose four to 145-7/8. Software maker Microsoft headed software shares, closing up two to 99-1/2.
Networking powerhouse Cisco Systems Inc fell 1-3/8 to 54-1/4. It was the most active stock, with 12.4 million shares traded.
It was trailed in the No. 2 spot by 3Com Corp, which fell 19/64 to 32-13/64. 3Com last week said it would acquire modem maker U.S. Robotics Corp.
